events.title: Moth Infestation
events.description: Patchwork moths nibble spare seams in the satchel.

choices.text: Feed a spare part to the moths (+2 scraps)
Fumigate the satchel (spend 1 scrap)
Escape before the moths spread

events.title: The Dye Vat
events.description: Indigo thread waits to strengthen a sewn body part.

choices.text: Raise a worn part one tier (spend 3 scraps)
Skim dyed thread (+1 scrap)
Leave the vat

events.title: Frayed Debt Parcel
events.description: Borrowed stitches offer stronger spare parts at a cost to composure.

choices.text: Take a tier II claw (requires DARK or SNUFFED candlelight, +25 fray to the party)
Take a tier II moth wing (+25 fray to the party)
Gather loose thread (+1 scrap)

events.title: The Needle Toll
events.description: The front living pioneer may pay six HP for a rare spare. Seven HP are required to pay safely.

choices.text: Front living pioneer pays 6 HP for a tier III claw
Pocket loose thread (+1 scrap)

events.title: The Glassfront Pin Cabinet
events.description: A giant glass-front sewing cabinet looms above the doll-sized passage; behind warped panes a plump button-eyed keeper sorts copper pins into black velvet drawers.

choices.text: Open a draughty pin tray (+3 scraps, -8 candle, +4 fray each)
Spend 2 scraps bracing the candle wick (+15 candle, -4 fray each)
Let the cabinet's velvet drawers close

events.title: The Moonblack Paperweight
events.description: A moonblack glass paperweight pins a torn house plan to the floorboards; a small cream-felt mapkeeper waits beneath its cold reflection, holding an ink-stained spool.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold for a reassuring house plan (-10 fray each)
Lift the shadowed weight (+23 gold, -10 candle, +7 fray each)
Leave the black glass holding down the plan

events.title: The Cinder-Brass Bedwarmer
events.description: A bedwarmer the size of a wagon glows behind a perforated brass lid; a soot-dark round ragdoll steadies its long wooden handle beside a threadbare carpet.

choices.text: Pay 11 gold to borrow glowing embers (requires candle below 100, +22 candle, +5 fray each)
Let the embers cool and sift loose screws (+2 scraps, -12 candle, -6 fray each)
Leave the bedwarmer glowing in the dark
